notes:
I found three real preschool swim options in Oakville. None of the pages I read gave a class day or time for fall, so I left `when` out wherever it wasn't posted.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Learn to Swim Parent and Tot / Preschool, Town of Oakville",
      "age_fit": "Preschool levels (Lifesaving Society Swim for Life); children must be the age required for the level by the program start date",
      "source_name": "Town of Oakville"
    },
    {
      "name": "YMCA Preschool Swim Lessons, YMCA of Oakville",
      "age_fit": "3-5 years",
      "when": "12-week sessions with a one-week break between sessions",
      "source_name": "YMCA of Oakville"
    },
    {
      "name": "Little Waves, Making Waves Swim School Oakville",
      "age_fit": "2-5 years",
      "when": "Weekly lessons, register anytime",
      "price": "$33.13 per lesson",
      "source_name": "Making Waves Swim School"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Town of Oakville:** The Town's registered-programs page says 
online registration for Fall programs is now open
. The class schedule and prices sit behind the Town's booking login, so I couldn't read them.
- **YMCA of Oakville:** The age band comes from the Y's page, which says 
3-5 years
. It also says its 
swim lessons operate in 12-week sessions with a one-week program break between sessions
. The page didn't give class days, times or a price.
- **Making Waves Swim School:** Their Oakville page lists 
2-5 years (Little Waves) at $33.13 / lesson
 and says 
Register anytime
. It showed the location's opening hours but no class times.
